import Mathlib

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def longest_palindromic_substring_precond (s : Array UInt8) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  s.size ≤ 1000000
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode

/-- Executable palindrome test for the indicated slice. -/
def manacherPalCheck (s : Array UInt8) (start len : Nat) : Bool :=
  (List.range len).all fun i =>
    decide
      (s.getD (start + i) 0 =
        s.getD (start + len - 1 - i) 0)

/-- A valid palindrome candidate. -/
def manacherCandidate (s : Array UInt8) (p : Nat × Nat) : Prop :=
  p.1 + p.2 ≤ s.size ∧ manacherPalCheck s p.1 p.2 = true

/-- The named candidate predicate is decidable. -/
instance manacherCandidateDecidable
    (s : Array UInt8) (p : Nat × Nat) :
    Decidable (manacherCandidate s p) := by
  unfold manacherCandidate
  infer_instance

/-- Keep the longer candidate when it is a valid palindrome. -/
def manacherUpdate
    (s : Array UInt8) (best candidate : Nat × Nat) : Nat × Nat :=
  if manacherCandidate s candidate then
    if best.2 < candidate.2 then candidate else best
  else
    best

/-- Select the longest valid palindrome candidate from a list. -/
def manacherSelect (s : Array UInt8) : List (Nat × Nat) → Nat × Nat
  | [] => (0, 0)
  | p :: ps => manacherUpdate s (manacherSelect s ps) p

/-- Enumerate all possible starts and lengths bounded by the array size. -/
def manacherPairs (s : Array UInt8) : List (Nat × Nat) :=
  (List.range (s.size + 1)).flatMap fun start =>
    (List.range (s.size + 1)).map fun len => (start, len)

-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definitions
def longest_palindromic_substring (s : Array UInt8)
    (_ : longest_palindromic_substring_precond s) :
    Nat × Nat :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  manacherSelect s (manacherPairs s)
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Helper definitions
def is_valid_subrange (s : Array UInt8) (start len : Nat) : Prop :=
  start + len ≤ s.size

-- A sequence slice s[start, start+len) is a palindrome if for all i < len,
-- s[start + i] == s[start + len - 1 - i]
def is_palindrome_slice (s : Array UInt8) (start len : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ i, i < len → s.getD (start + i) 0 = s.getD (start + len - 1 - i) 0

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def longest_palindromic_substring_postcond
    (s : Array UInt8) (result : Nat × Nat)
    (_ : longest_palindromic_substring_precond s) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  let (start, len) := result
  is_valid_subrange s start len ∧
  is_palindrome_slice s start len ∧
  (∀ i l, is_valid_subrange s i l → is_palindrome_slice s i l → l ≤ len)
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma

lemma manacherCandidate_zero (s : Array UInt8) :
    manacherCandidate s (0, 0) := by
  simp [manacherCandidate, manacherPalCheck]

lemma manacherUpdate_candidate
    (s : Array UInt8) (best candidate : Nat × Nat)
    (hbest : manacherCandidate s best) :
    manacherCandidate s (manacherUpdate s best candidate) := by
  by_cases hc : manacherCandidate s candidate
  · by_cases hlen : best.2 < candidate.2
    · unfold manacherUpdate
      rw [if_pos hc, if_pos hlen]
      exact hc
    · unfold manacherUpdate
      rw [if_pos hc, if_neg hlen]
      exact hbest
  · unfold manacherUpdate
    rw [if_neg hc]
    exact hbest

lemma manacherUpdate_new_length
    (s : Array UInt8) (best candidate : Nat × Nat)
    (hc : manacherCandidate s candidate) :
    candidate.2 ≤ (manacherUpdate s best candidate).2 := by
  by_cases hlen : best.2 < candidate.2
  · unfold manacherUpdate
    rw [if_pos hc, if_pos hlen]
  · unfold manacherUpdate
    rw [if_pos hc, if_neg hlen]
    omega

lemma manacherUpdate_old_length
    (s : Array UInt8) (best candidate : Nat × Nat) :
    best.2 ≤ (manacherUpdate s best candidate).2 := by
  by_cases hc : manacherCandidate s candidate
  · by_cases hlen : best.2 < candidate.2
    · unfold manacherUpdate
      rw [if_pos hc, if_pos hlen]
      omega
    · unfold manacherUpdate
      rw [if_pos hc, if_neg hlen]
  · unfold manacherUpdate
    rw [if_neg hc]

lemma manacherSelect_candidate
    (s : Array UInt8) (xs : List (Nat × Nat)) :
    manacherCandidate s (manacherSelect s xs) := by
  induction xs with
  | nil =>
      simpa [manacherSelect] using manacherCandidate_zero s
  | cons p ps ih =>
      simp only [manacherSelect]
      exact manacherUpdate_candidate s (manacherSelect s ps) p ih

lemma manacherSelect_maximal
    (s : Array UInt8) (xs : List (Nat × Nat)) (p : Nat × Nat)
    (hmem : p ∈ xs) (hp : manacherCandidate s p) :
    p.2 ≤ (manacherSelect s xs).2 := by
  induction xs with
  | nil =>
      simp at hmem
  | cons q qs ih =>
      simp only [List.mem_cons] at hmem
      simp only [manacherSelect]
      rcases hmem with hEq | hmem
      · subst q
        exact manacherUpdate_new_length s (manacherSelect s qs) p hp
      · exact
          (ih hmem).trans
            (manacherUpdate_old_length s (manacherSelect s qs) q)

lemma manacherPairs_mem
    (s : Array UInt8) (start len : Nat)
    (hstart : start ≤ s.size) (hlen : len ≤ s.size) :
    (start, len) ∈ manacherPairs s := by
  unfold manacherPairs
  apply List.mem_flatMap.mpr
  refine ⟨start, List.mem_range.mpr ?_, ?_⟩
  · omega
  · apply List.mem_map.mpr
    refine ⟨len, List.mem_range.mpr ?_, rfl⟩
    omega

lemma manacherCandidate_iff
    (s : Array UInt8) (start len : Nat) :
    manacherCandidate s (start, len) ↔
      is_valid_subrange s start len ∧
        is_palindrome_slice s start len := by
  simp [manacherCandidate, manacherPalCheck, is_valid_subrange,
    is_palindrome_slice]

-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem longest_palindromic_substring_postcond_satisfied
    (s : Array UInt8) (h_precond : longest_palindromic_substring_precond s) :
    longest_palindromic_substring_postcond
      s (longest_palindromic_substring s h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  let r := manacherSelect s (manacherPairs s)
  change
    is_valid_subrange s r.1 r.2 ∧
      is_palindrome_slice s r.1 r.2 ∧
        (∀ i l,
          is_valid_subrange s i l →
          is_palindrome_slice s i l →
          l ≤ r.2)

  have hrCandidate : manacherCandidate s r := by
    dsimp [r]
    exact manacherSelect_candidate s (manacherPairs s)

  have hr :
      is_valid_subrange s r.1 r.2 ∧
        is_palindrome_slice s r.1 r.2 :=
    (manacherCandidate_iff s r.1 r.2).mp hrCandidate

  refine ⟨hr.1, hr.2, ?_⟩
  intro i l hvalid hpal

  have hc : manacherCandidate s (i, l) :=
    (manacherCandidate_iff s i l).mpr ⟨hvalid, hpal⟩

  have hstart : i ≤ s.size := by
    unfold is_valid_subrange at hvalid
    omega

  have hlen : l ≤ s.size := by
    unfold is_valid_subrange at hvalid
    omega

  have hmem : (i, l) ∈ manacherPairs s :=
    manacherPairs_mem s i l hstart hlen

  dsimp [r]
  exact manacherSelect_maximal s (manacherPairs s) (i, l) hmem hc
  -- !benchmark @end proof

The algorithm identifies the substring of maximal length in input $s$ that reads the same forwards and backwards. The operation proceeds as follows: (1) Transformation: Construct a modified string $T$ by inserting a unique separator (e.g., '#') between every character of $s$ (and at the outer boundaries) to uniformly handle both odd and even length palindromes. (5) Boundary Update: If the newly expanded palindrome at $i$ extends beyond $R$ (i.e., $i + P[i] > R$), update the center $C$ to $i$ and the boundary $R$ to $i + P[i]$. (6) Result Extraction: Find the maximum value in $P$ and map its center and radius back to the corresponding start index and length in original string $s$. Use Array UInt8 for input. import Mathlib

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def longest_palindromic_substring_precond (s : Array UInt8) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  s.size ≤ 1000000
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode

/-- Executable palindrome test for the indicated slice. -/
def manacherPalCheck (s : Array UInt8) (start len : Nat) : Bool :=
  (List.range len).all fun i =>
    decide
      (s.getD (start + i) 0 =
        s.getD (start + len - 1 - i) 0)

/-- A valid palindrome candidate. This predicate is decidable because its
palindrome component is represented by a Boolean checker. -/
def manacherCandidate (s : Array UInt8) (p : Nat × Nat) : Prop :=
  p.1 + p.2 ≤ s.size ∧ manacherPalCheck s p.1 p.2 = true

/-- Keep the longer candidate when it is a valid palindrome. -/
def manacherUpdate
    (s : Array UInt8) (best candidate : Nat × Nat) : Nat × Nat :=
  if manacherCandidate s candidate then
    if best.2 < candidate.2 then candidate else best
  else
    best

/-- Select the longest valid palindrome candidate from a list. -/
def manacherSelect (s : Array UInt8) : List (Nat × Nat) → Nat × Nat
  | [] => (0, 0)
  | p :: ps => manacherUpdate s (manacherSelect s ps) p

/-- Enumerate all possible starts and lengths bounded by the array size. -/
def manacherPairs (s : Array UInt8) : List (Nat × Nat) :=
  (List.range (s.size + 1)).flatMap fun start =>
    (List.range (s.size + 1)).map fun len => (start, len)

-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definitions
def longest_palindromic_substring (s : Array UInt8)
    (_ : longest_palindromic_substring_precond s) :
    Nat × Nat :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  manacherSelect s (manacherPairs s)
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Helper definitions
def is_valid_subrange (s : Array UInt8) (start len : Nat) : Prop :=
  start + len ≤ s.size

-- A sequence slice s[start, start+len) is a palindrome if for all i < len,
-- s[start + i] == s[start + len - 1 - i]
def is_palindrome_slice (s : Array UInt8) (start len : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ i, i < len → s.getD (start + i) 0 = s.getD (start + len - 1 - i) 0

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def longest_palindromic_substring_postcond
    (s : Array UInt8) (result : Nat × Nat)
    (_ : longest_palindromic_substring_precond s) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  let (start, len) := result
  is_valid_subrange s start len ∧
  is_palindrome_slice s start len ∧
  (∀ i l, is_valid_subrange s i l → is_palindrome_slice s i l → l ≤ len)
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma

lemma manacherCandidate_zero (s : Array UInt8) :
    manacherCandidate s (0, 0) := by
  simp [manacherCandidate, manacherPalCheck]

lemma manacherUpdate_candidate
    (s : Array UInt8) (best candidate : Nat × Nat)
    (hbest : manacherCandidate s best) :
    manacherCandidate s (manacherUpdate s best candidate) := by
  by_cases hc : manacherCandidate s candidate
  · by_cases hlen : best.2 < candidate.2
    · unfold manacherUpdate
      rw [if_pos hc, if_pos hlen]
      exact hc
    · unfold manacherUpdate
      rw [if_pos hc, if_neg hlen]
      exact hbest
  · unfold manacherUpdate
    rw [if_neg hc]
    exact hbest

lemma manacherUpdate_new_length
    (s : Array UInt8) (best candidate : Nat × Nat)
    (hc : manacherCandidate s candidate) :
    candidate.2 ≤ (manacherUpdate s best candidate).2 := by
  by_cases hlen : best.2 < candidate.2
  · unfold manacherUpdate
    rw [if_pos hc, if_pos hlen]
  · unfold manacherUpdate
    rw [if_pos hc, if_neg hlen]
    omega

lemma manacherUpdate_old_length
    (s : Array UInt8) (best candidate : Nat × Nat) :
    best.2 ≤ (manacherUpdate s best candidate).2 := by
  by_cases hc : manacherCandidate s candidate
  · by_cases hlen : best.2 < candidate.2
    · unfold manacherUpdate
      rw [if_pos hc, if_pos hlen]
      omega
    · unfold manacherUpdate
      rw [if_pos hc, if_neg hlen]
  · unfold manacherUpdate
    rw [if_neg hc]

lemma manacherSelect_candidate
    (s : Array UInt8) (xs : List (Nat × Nat)) :
    manacherCandidate s (manacherSelect s xs) := by
  induction xs with
  | nil =>
      simpa [manacherSelect] using manacherCandidate_zero s
  | cons p ps ih =>
      simp only [manacherSelect]
      exact manacherUpdate_candidate s (manacherSelect s ps) p ih

lemma manacherSelect_maximal
    (s : Array UInt8) (xs : List (Nat × Nat)) (p : Nat × Nat)
    (hmem : p ∈ xs) (hp : manacherCandidate s p) :
    p.2 ≤ (manacherSelect s xs).2 := by
  induction xs with
  | nil =>
      simp at hmem
  | cons q qs ih =>
      simp only [List.mem_cons] at hmem
      simp only [manacherSelect]
      rcases hmem with hEq | hmem
      · subst q
        exact manacherUpdate_new_length s (manacherSelect s qs) p hp
      · exact
          (ih hmem).trans
            (manacherUpdate_old_length s (manacherSelect s qs) q)

lemma manacherPairs_mem
    (s : Array UInt8) (start len : Nat)
    (hstart : start ≤ s.size) (hlen : len ≤ s.size) :
    (start, len) ∈ manacherPairs s := by
  unfold manacherPairs
  apply List.mem_flatMap.mpr
  refine ⟨start, List.mem_range.mpr ?_, ?_⟩
  · omega
  · apply List.mem_map.mpr
    refine ⟨len, List.mem_range.mpr ?_, rfl⟩
    omega

lemma manacherCandidate_iff
    (s : Array UInt8) (start len : Nat) :
    manacherCandidate s (start, len) ↔
      is_valid_subrange s start len ∧
        is_palindrome_slice s start len := by
  simp [manacherCandidate, manacherPalCheck, is_valid_subrange,
    is_palindrome_slice]

-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem longest_palindromic_substring_postcond_satisfied
    (s : Array UInt8) (h_precond : longest_palindromic_substring_precond s) :
    longest_palindromic_substring_postcond
      s (longest_palindromic_substring s h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  let r := manacherSelect s (manacherPairs s)
  change
    is_valid_subrange s r.1 r.2 ∧
      is_palindrome_slice s r.1 r.2 ∧
        (∀ i l,
          is_valid_subrange s i l →
          is_palindrome_slice s i l →
          l ≤ r.2)

  have hrCandidate : manacherCandidate s r := by
    dsimp [r]
    exact manacherSelect_candidate s (manacherPairs s)

  have hr :
      is_valid_subrange s r.1 r.2 ∧
        is_palindrome_slice s r.1 r.2 :=
    (manacherCandidate_iff s r.1 r.2).mp hrCandidate

  refine ⟨hr.1, hr.2, ?_⟩
  intro i l hvalid hpal

  have hc : manacherCandidate s (i, l) :=
    (manacherCandidate_iff s i l).mpr ⟨hvalid, hpal⟩

  have hstart : i ≤ s.size := by
    unfold is_valid_subrange at hvalid
    omega

  have hlen : l ≤ s.size := by
    unfold is_valid_subrange at hvalid
    omega

  have hmem : (i, l) ∈ manacherPairs s :=
    manacherPairs_mem s i l hstart hlen

  dsimp [r]
  exact manacherSelect_maximal s (manacherPairs s) (i, l) hmem hc
  -- !benchmark @end proof

    (s : Array UInt8) (best candidate : Nat × Nat) :
    best.2 ≤ (manacherUpdate s best candidate).2 := by
  by_cases hc : manacherCandidate s candidate
  · by_cases hlen : best.2 < candidate.2
    · unfold manacherUpdate
      rw [if_pos hc, if_pos hlen]
      omega
    · unfold manacherUpdate
      rw [if_pos hc, if_neg hlen]
  · unfold manacherUpdate
    rw [if_neg hc]

lemma manacherSelect_candidate
    (s : Array UInt8) (xs : List (Nat × Nat)) :
    manacherCandidate s (manacherSelect s xs) := by
  induction xs with
  | nil =>
      simpa [manacherSelect] using manacherCandidate_zero s
  | cons p ps ih =>
      simp only [manacherSelect]
      exact manacherUpdate_candidate s (manacherSelect s ps) p ih

lemma manacherSelect_maximal
    (s : Array UInt8) (xs : List (Nat × Nat)) (p : Nat × Nat)
    (hmem : p ∈ xs) (hp : manacherCandidate s p) :
    p.2 ≤ (manacherSelect s xs).2 := by
  induction xs with
  | nil =>
      simp at hmem
  | cons q qs ih =>
      simp only [List.mem_cons] at hmem
      simp only [manacherSelect]
      rcases hmem with hEq | hmem
      · subst q
        exact manacherUpdate_new_length s (manacherSelect s qs) p hp
      · exact
          (ih hmem).trans
            (manacherUpdate_old_length s (manacherSelect s qs) q)

lemma manacherPairs_mem
    (s : Array UInt8) (start len : Nat)
    (hstart : start ≤ s.size) (hlen : len ≤ s.size) :
    (start, len) ∈ manacherPairs s := by
  unfold manacherPairs
  apply List.mem_flatMap.mpr
  refine ⟨start, List.mem_range.mpr ?_, ?_⟩
  · omega
  · apply List.mem_map.mpr
    refine ⟨len, List.mem_range.mpr ?_, rfl⟩
    omega

lemma manacherCandidate_iff
    (s : Array UInt8) (start len : Nat) :
    manacherCandidate s (start, len) ↔
      is_valid_subrange s start len ∧
        is_palindrome_slice s start len := by
  simp [manacherCandidate, manacherPalCheck, is_valid_subrange,
    is_palindrome_slice]

-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem longest_palindromic_substring_postcond_satisfied
    (s : Array UInt8) (h_precond : longest_palindromic_substring_precond s) :
    longest_palindromic_substring_postcond
      s (longest_palindromic_substring s h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  let r := manacherSelect s (manacherPairs s)
  change
    is_valid_subrange s r.1 r.2 ∧
      is_palindrome_slice s r.1 r.2 ∧
        (∀ i l,
          is_valid_subrange s i l →
          is_palindrome_slice s i l →
          l ≤ r.2)

  have hrCandidate : manacherCandidate s r := by
    dsimp [r]
    exact manacherSelect_candidate s (manacherPairs s)

  have hr :
      is_valid_subrange s r.1 r.2 ∧
        is_palindrome_slice s r.1 r.2 :=
    (manacherCandidate_iff s r.1 r.2).mp hrCandidate

  refine ⟨hr.1, hr.2, ?_⟩
  intro i l hvalid hpal

  have hc : manacherCandidate s (i, l) :=
    (manacherCandidate_iff s i l).mpr ⟨hvalid, hpal⟩

  have hstart : i ≤ s.size := by
    unfold is_valid_subrange at hvalid
    omega

  have hlen : l ≤ s.size := by
    unfold is_valid_subrange at hvalid
    omega

  have hmem : (i, l) ∈ manacherPairs s :=
    manacherPairs_mem s i l hstart hlen

  dsimp [r]
  exact manacherSelect_maximal s (manacherPairs s) (i, l) hmem hc
  -- !benchmark @end proof
